title: moniera calycina
intro: Moniera calycina, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to improve cognitive function, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Indian pennywort are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-diabetic properties. Additionally, the plant's leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders.
